        sub=frames[part*24:(part+1)*24]
        sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1536,310*math.ceil(len(sub)/3)),(230,230,230))

+if content_path.exists():
+    content = {x['id']: x for x in json.loads(content_path.read_text())}
+else:
+    content = {}
+
+def timestamp(seconds):
+    millis = round(seconds * 1000)
+    hours, millis = divmod(millis, 3600000)
+    minutes, millis = divmod(millis, 60000)
+    secs, millis = divmod(millis, 1000)
+    return f'{hours:02}:{minutes:02}:{secs:02},{millis:03}'
+
+zh_blocks, en_blocks, segment_rows = [], [], []
+for index, segment in enumerate(manifest['segments'], 1):
+    item = content.get(segment['id'], {})
+    start = float(item.get('start', segment['start'] + 0.45))
+    end = float(item.get('end', min(segment['end'] - 0.15, start + 6.8)))
+    end = min(end, segment['end'])
+    if end - start < 0.8:
+        start = max(segment['start'], end - 0.8)
+    zh = item.get('zh', '[无法确认]')
+    en = item.get('en', '[unclear]')
+    times = f'{timestamp(start)} --> {timestamp(end)}'
+    zh_blocks.append(f'{index}\\n{times}\\n{zh}\\n')
+    en_blocks.append(f'{index}\\n{times}\\n{en}\\n')
+    segment_rows.append({
+        'id': segment['id'], 'zh_cues': [index], 'en_cues': [index],
+        'confidence_zh': float(item.get('confidence_zh', 0.08)),
+        'confidence_en': float(item.get('confidence_en', 0.08)),
+        'uncertainty': item.get('uncertainty', '手语内容尚未确认。')
+    })
+(RESULTS / 'zh-CN.srt').write_text('\\n'.join(zh_blocks), encoding='utf-8')
+(RESULTS / 'en.srt').write_text('\\n'.join(en_blocks), encoding='utf-8')
+(RESULTS / 'segments.json').write_text(json.dumps({'segments': segment_rows}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\\n', encoding='utf-8')
+subprocess.run([
+    'ffmpeg', '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-y', '-i', str(ROOT / 'input/source.mp4'),
+    '-i', str(RESULTS / 'zh-CN.srt'), '-i', str(RESULTS / 'en.srt'),

+    '-metadata:s:s:0', 'language=zho', '-metadata:s:s:0', 'title=简体中文',
+    '-metadata:s:s:1', 'language=eng', '-metadata:s:s:1', 'title=English',
+    str(RESULTS / 'subtitled.mkv')
+], check=True)
+
+cue_re = re.compile(r'(\\d+)\\n(\\d\\d):(\\d\\d):(\\d\\d),(\\d\\d\\d) --> (\\d\\d):(\\d\\d):(\\d\\d),(\\d\\d\\d)\\n(["'^'"\\n]+(?:\\n["'^'"\\n]+)?)')
+for lang, path, line_limit, rate_limit in [('zh', RESULTS / 'zh-CN.srt', 22, 9), ('en', RESULTS / 'en.srt', 42, 20)]:

+    previous_end = -1

+        start = values[0] * 3600 + values[1] * 60 + values[2] + values[3] / 1000
+        end = values[4] * 3600 + values[5] * 60 + values[6] + values[7] / 1000

+        count = len(re.sub(r'\\s', '', match.group(10))) if lang == 'zh' else len(match.group(10).replace('\\n', ' '))
+        assert count / (end - start) <= rate_limit, (lang, expected, count / (end - start))

import numpy as np, scipy.io.wavfile as wav
from scipy.signal import stft
sr, y = wav.read('audio.wav')
y = y.astype(np.float32)
if y.ndim>1: y=y.mean(axis=1)
y/= (np.abs(y).max()+1e-9)
nper, hop = 2048, 128
f,t,Z = stft(y, fs=sr, nperseg=nper, noverlap=nper-hop, padded=False)
M = np.abs(Z)
# spectral flux
dM = np.diff(M,axis=1)
dM[dM<0]=0
flux = dM.sum(axis=0)
tt = t[1:]
# adaptive threshold
from scipy.ndimage import median_filter, maximum_filter1d
med = median_filter(flux, size=51)
thr = med*1.8 + np.percentile(flux,60)*0.5
cand = (flux>thr)&(flux>maximum_filter1d(flux,size=15)*0.999)
pk = np.where(cand)[0]
# merge close peaks (<50ms)
onsets=[]
last=-100
for i in pk:
    if tt[i]-last<0.05:
        if flux[i]>flux[onsets[-1][0]]: onsets[-1]=(i,tt[i])
    else:
        onsets.append((i,tt[i]))
    last=tt[i]
ons = np.array([o[1] for o in onsets])

from scipy import signal
z=np.load('/work/analysis/stft.npz'); f=z['f'];t=z['t'];M=z['M'].astype(float)
midis=np.arange(21,109); f0=440*2**((midis-69)/12)
# local spectral peak sampler
H=np.zeros((88,12,len(t)))
for j,fr in enumerate(f0):
 for h in range(1,13):
  fh=fr*h*(1+0.00015*h*h)**.5
  if fh>7000:continue
  k=np.argmin(abs(f-fh)); radius=1 if fh<1000 else 2
  H[j,h-1]=M[max(0,k-radius):k+radius+1].max(axis=0)

def candidates(tm,topn=20):
 post=(t>=tm+.015)&(t<=tm+.13); pre=(t>=tm-.18)&(t<=tm-.035)
 A=np.max(H[:,:,post],axis=2); B=np.median(H[:,:,pre],axis=2)
 eps=2e-5
 lr=np.log((A+eps)/(B+eps))
 ab=np.log(A+eps)+9
 scores=[]
 for j,m in enumerate(midis):
  n=min(10,np.count_nonzero(H[j,:,0]))
  hs=np.arange(1,13)[:n];w=1/hs**.7

  pos=np.maximum(0,lr[j,:n]-0.15)

  fund=max(0,lr[j,0]-.1)
  absval=(w*np.maximum(0,ab[j,:n]-2)).sum()/w.sum()
  scores.append(s+.22*fund+.08*absval)
 scores=np.array(scores)
 ix=np.argsort(scores)[::-1][:topn]
 return [(int(midis[i]),round(scores[i],2),round(lr[i,0],2),round(ab[i,0],2)) for i in ix]
